# Unitdice

> Unitdice is an early-stage studio in Gwangju, South Korea. It develops games, AI games where AI writes the story and the choices, and AI-driven services.

Korean / 한국어: Unitdice는 대한민국 광주에 있는 초기 스타트업 스튜디오입니다. 게임 개발, AI가 스토리와 선택지를 쓰는 AI 게임, AI 기반 서비스를 만듭니다.

## What we do
- Game development: Original games we plan and build ourselves, from fast action to physics-driven play, ready to play in the browser.
- AI-native games: Games where AI is part of the creative work: it writes the story and the choices, so every playthrough can unfold differently.
- AI-driven services: Services with AI inside, like an assistant that answers questions from your documents, and services we build with AI, like delivery route optimization.

## Products
- [Galaxy S25 Assistant](https://chat.unitdice.com/): An AI chatbot that answers questions from the Galaxy S25 user manual. Pick Fast mode for quick answers or Careful + Web mode to also check the web.
- [Ball Sim](https://unitdice.com/game): A ball game in development. The lobby, shop, inventory and achievements are ready to look around; gameplay comes next.
- [Gwangju delivery route comparison](https://unitdice.com/delivery/): Compares an exact method and a cluster-based method on the same stops over Gwangju's real road network. Routes come out up to 92% shorter than visiting stops in no particular order.
- [IT helpdesk booking](https://help.unitdice.com/): Book IT helpdesk visits by office in one-hour slots. Google Sheets works as the database: bookings are saved to the sheet, open slots are read from it, and admins manage bookings right in the sheet.
